LESSON: HADITH ON PLANTING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Hadith 2.2 Hadith on dressing (3 Lessons) By the end of the sub- strand, the lea
Topic 2.3: Hadith on planting

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Hadith on planting. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the dangers of cutting down trees?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
3. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: HADITH ON PLANTING
This lesson teaches Hadith on planting for Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

STUDY STEPS
1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Hadith on planting using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Hadith on planting above.
2. Explain Hadith on planting to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Hadith on planting.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Hadith on planting with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Hadith on planting important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the dangers of cutting down trees?
2. What are the benefits of growing trees and crops?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. read the Hadith on planting of trees and crops for environmental consciousness
2. plant trees and crops for food sustainability to earn rewards from Allah
3. appreciate the value of planting trees and crops for the benefit of Allah’s creatures

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
